CVE-2026-105454.title: Stored XSS via crafted URLs in HTML ticket content in Request Tracker
CVE-2026-105454.description:
RT's automatic link creation for URLs in HTML ticket content does
not HTML-escape the URL it places in the link. A URL crafted to
break out of the link's address can add a script that runs when the
ticket history is displayed, with no further action by the viewer.
Anyone who can add HTML content to a ticket can plant it. That
includes an unauthenticated sender of HTML email to any queue that
grants CreateTicket or ReplyToTicket to Everyone, which is routine
for a queue that accepts mail from the public. The script runs in
the session of any user who views the ticket, and can act in RT
with that user's authority.

This issue was fixed in version 5.0.11 and 6.0.4

CVE-2026-109151.title: Deleting a Matter Credential Issuer clears the adjacent issuer's Aliro ValidityIteration state
CVE-2026-109151.description:
In
the Matter and Aliro Door Lock Application of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door
Lock and Access Control Add-on v1.0.0 through v1.1.1 with
CONFIG_DOOR_LOCK_STEP_UP_PHASE enabled, deleting a Credential Issuer passes the
1-based Matter credential index to ClearValidityIterations(), which expects a
0-based storage index. The intended issuer's ValidityIteration state is left in
place, and the state of the adjacent, still-provisioned issuer is cleared. This
resets that issuer's rollback protection. An attacker holding an older but correctly
signed Access Document from the adjacent issuer, whose validity iteration had
been superseded, can then potentially obtain physical access. Fixed in v1.2.0.

The Symfony HttpClient component NoPrivateNetworkHttpClient does not pin the checked IP address of cached hosts, allowing for DNS rebinding to bypass private network restrictions, resulting in enumeration of internal hosts and ports in Symfony versions prior to 5.4.56, 6.x prior to 6.4.50, 7.x prior to 7.4.23, and 8.x prior to 8.1.11.

CVE-2026-99649.title: mm/ksm: check large swap-cache folios before mapping them
CVE-2026-99649.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/ksm: check large swap-cache folios before mapping them

KSM folios are always small, but their shared swap slots can be read
back as part of a large folio in the swap cache. ksm_might_need_to_copy()
skips large folios, so another process can map a page with an incompatible
anon_vma or page index. Reverse mapping then cannot find the new
mapping, preventing migration or reclaim.

Apply the same compatibility checks to large folios as to small ones.
Pass the page corresponding to the swap entry and copy only that page
when necessary. In do_swap_page()'s copy path, decrement only that slot's
swap count, because the source swap-cache folio can now be large.

Fix generated by an LLM and sent by Chris Mason in private.

CVE-2026-99775.title: xfrm: interface: validate the IP header on xmit
CVE-2026-99775.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xfrm: interface: validate the IP header on xmit

Packets injected into an xfrm interface (e.g. AF_PACKET on an xfrmi
device) reach the xfrm output path without IP header validation, but
xfrm4_transport_output() uses iph->ihl for __skb_pull() and memmove()
and expects the header to be valid.

vti_tunnel_xmit() already calls pskb_inet_may_pull() before handing
packets to the xfrm output path. Do the same in xfrmi_xmit() and
perform the header checks ip_rcv_core()/ip6_rcv_core() do on entry
to the IP stack: reject wrong IP versions and malformed IPv4 header
lengths.
